sourceLeads.title: BC Infrastructure Benefits Statement of Financial Information 2024/25
sourceLeads.nextAction: Reconcile this source lead with an accepted source manifest.
notes: The official report index uses href=# with public onclick window.open PDF URLs; the URLs were read directly from the public HTML.
No records or identity links are accepted through this source-discovery entry.

Complete named employee schedule; board/director, supplier, unnamed, aggregate and reconciliation rows excluded. Source names/initials retained without name expansion or identity inference; comma spacing normalized. Repeated names remain distinct observations.

The reported remuneration column is preserved as published and is not assumed to be base salary. Expenses remain separate. Printed dash/blank expense cells are null; printed numeric zeros remain 0. No amount is changed to reconcile controls.
Note 1: Remuneration includes base salary and other compensation for 2024/25.
Note 2: Majority of expenses are related to employee travel and living out allowances.

All named employees in this legal employer’s published employee table are included. Earlier reports do not identify an individual employee’s corporate/project cohort; no category or title is inferred.

The original asterisk denotes unionized skilled trades workers working on select provincial infrastructure projects and collectively representing 95% of total remuneration paid by BCIB. Asterisks are preserved by row index in the evidence receipt and removed from normalized name strings; unmarked employees are not assigned an inferred role.
